algorithm.description: Search from search_start, find ALL offsets where ALL tier-1 positive flags match, then return FIRST offset with ALL negative flags UNSET. If no perfect match, prefer highest negative score, then highest positive score, then lowest offset.

71100.notes: Leyndell graces - MARKED UNRELIABLE 2026-01-25: Base 2593 was verified on saves WITH Leyndell progression, but may cause false positives on saves without Leyndell access. NO validation anchor exists for this block. DO NOT use for auto-complete.

However, for saves WITHOUT VM discovered, offset 3198 contains DIFFERENT data that causes false positives (e.g., flag 71600 Rykard showing as SET when it shouldn't be). 520000.notes: Spirit Ashes/Talismans - VERIFIED 2026-02-01: 12/15 cases verified via case-based system. SPARSE ALLOCATION: Block has padding gaps - flags 520210, 520330, 520450 fall into unallocated regions (0xFF in all slots). These items may use different flag ranges or be deprecated entries. Working ranges confirmed: ~520000-520189, ~520220-520319, ~520345-520449, ~520465+.

tile_formula.notes: REVERTED 2026-01-25: base_offset restored to 485330. Previous correction to 489981 was WRONG. Re-verified via Smoldering Butterfly: flag 1043500010 changes offset 852831 (not 857482). Calculation: 485330 + (43-33)*40*875 + (50-30)*875 + 10//8 = 485330 + 350000 + 17500 + 1 = 852831.

510000.notes: Remembrance consumption flags - VERIFIED 2026-01-23: Base 63750 derived from event_flags.rs hardcoded data. Formula: byte = 63750 + (flag_id - 510000) / 8, bit = 7 - (flag_id % 8). Verified mappings: 510010→(63751,5), 510020→(63752,3), 510030→(63753,1), 510040→(63755,7). 64 remembrance flags in this block. Flags SET when remembrance is USED at Enia, not when obtained.

520000.notes: Spirit Ash/Talisman catacomb rewards - VERIFIED 2026-01-31: Base 1341 discovered via inventory-driven differential. 12/15 key flags verified (S0=set, S1=unset). Flags 520210, 520330, 520450 land in 0xFF padding gaps within block. Block has discontinuous data with internal padding at offsets +7-10, +23-26, +40-41, +56-57.

540000.notes: Sorcery/Incantation/Ash of War unlock flags - VERIFIED 2026-01-22: Formula byte_offset = 67500 + (flag_id - 540000) // 8 matches 129/129 flags in event_flags.rs hardcoded data. Range covers 540100-540652.

710000.notes: Roundtable Hold NPC progression flags - VERIFIED 2026-01-23: Base 13875 derived from event_flags.rs hardcoded 710620→(0x3680,3). Formula: byte = 13875 + (flag_id - 710000) / 8, bit = 7 - (flag_id % 8). 41 EMEVD flags primarily from m18 (Roundtable Hold). Most track NPC state changes during game progression.
